name: Four Seasons Place
tagline: 519 designer suites atop Hong Kong Station — Studio to Penthouse, with Four Seasons-affiliated service in the ifc complex.
description:
A LUXURY SERVICED SUITE HOTEL IN THE HEART OF CENTRAL. SUITE HOTEL LIVING ATOP HONG KONG STATION BY THE HARBOUR.

Four Seasons Place offers luxury serviced apartment living at a prime location adorned with magnificent views in the heart of Central. Featuring a full range of world class facilities and the famed Four Seasons intuitive service, Four Seasons Place serviced apartment blends tasteful living with elegant comfort and superb convenience.

Four Seasons Place is jointly developed by Sun Hung Kai Properties & Henderson Land and affiliated with the Four Seasons Hotel Brand, extending its hallmark of world-class service and luxurious living. Four Seasons Place offers both long-stay and short-stay luxury serviced apartments with hotel-style amenities, presenting a premium residential experience that complements the adjacent Four Seasons Hotel.

SUITE HOTEL LIVING. Designed by acclaimed Yabu Pushelberg and Bilkey Llinas Design. An inspired impeccable collaboration between Yabu Pushelberg and Bilkey Llinas Design allows Four Seasons Place to offer elegant comfort and intelligent use of space, providing guests the ultimate experience of luxury living. Yabu Pushelberg specializes in luxury interiors and is well known for its timeless and artistic designs. It has been honoured with the Platinum Circle award for exceptional achievement in the hospitality industry and was the winner of the International Interior Design Association Star Award in 2014. Bilkey Llinas Design is another name often associated with impressive architectural planning and interior design for the hospitality industry. It also counts the Four Seasons Mumbai and Four Seasons Bahrain among its notable design portfolio of major hotel developments throughout Asia Pacific and Europe.

519 suites ranging from studios to one-, two- and three-bedroom suites plus penthouses are available at Four Seasons Place. Official room types on the homepage: Studio — Suite 27 Bilkey Llinas Design; 1 Bedroom — Suite 23 Yabu Pushelberg Design; 2 Bedroom — Suite 37 Yabu Pushelberg Design; 3 Bedroom — Suite 33 Yabu Pushelberg Design.

SUITE TYPE — STUDIO. In-room provision list: 55/65" SMART TV; In-room security safe; Washing and Drying Unit; Microwave with Grill; Refrigerator; Electric Hob; Range of small appliances and tableware; DAB radio with alarm clock. VR 360 — Suite 27 Bilkey Llinas Design; VR 360 — Suite 35 Yabu Pushelberg Design.

SUITE TYPE — 1 BEDROOM. In-room provision list: 55/65" SMART TV; Bose Home Entertainment System; In-room security safe; Washing and Drying Unit; Microwave with Grill; Dishwasher; Refrigerator; Electric Hob; Range of small appliances and tableware; DAB radio with alarm clock. VR 360 — Suite 23 Yabu Pushelberg Design; VR 360 — Suite 25 Bilkey Llinas Design; VR 360 — Suite 42 Yabu Pushelberg Design.

SUITE TYPE — 2 BEDROOM. In-room provision list: 55/65" SMART TV; Bose Home Entertainment System; In-room security safe; Washing and Drying Unit; Microwave with oven; Dishwasher; Refrigerator; Electric Hob; Range of small appliances and tableware; DAB radio with alarm clock. VR 360 — Suite 37 Yabu Pushelberg Design; VR 360 — Suite 39 Bilkey Llinas Design; VR 360 — Suite 30 Bilkey Llinas Design.

SUITE TYPE — 3 BEDROOM. In-room provision list: 55/65" SMART TV; Bose Home Entertainment System; In-room security safe; Washing and Drying Unit; Microwave with oven; Dishwasher; Refrigerator; Electric Hob; Range of small appliances and tableware; DAB radio with alarm clock. VR 360 — Suite 33 Yabu Pushelberg Design; VR 360 — Suite 33 Bilkey Llinas Design.

SUITE TYPE — PENTHOUSE. At the very top of Four Seasons Place are the two most prestigious and sought-after penthouses. The East Penthouse designed by Yabu Pushelberg is 2,790 sq. ft. with a private roof and terrace of 2,094 sq. ft. The West Penthouse by Bilkey Llinas Design is 3,562 sq. ft. with a private roof terrace of 2,286 sq. ft. Both penthouses are luxuriously and tastefully decorated, and have a master bedroom with walk-in closets, one or two bedrooms with en suites, a study, kitchen fitted with top-of-the-range appliances, powder room and maid’s room. Both private roofs have coveted heated swimming pools with a counter flow and massage jet, as well as pavilions complete with world-class barbecue facilities.

FACILITIES & SERVICES. State-of-the-art facilities for all business needs. Guests at Four Seasons Place can take advantage of the multi-function family room on 59th floor for meetings. Our concierge also provides a comprehensive range of business amenities and secretarial services. A leisurely lifestyle, high above. Four Seasons Place pampers guests with its luxurious leisure facilities. The Sky Lounge on the 59th floor offers a spacious, comfortable lounge for relaxation in front of the breathtaking view of Victoria Harbour. Adjacent to it is the rooftop pool complete with a heated Jacuzzi and a 24-hour gym with full fitness facilities. Welcome to the Orient — a hand-holding welcome. Here, a dedicated team of Guest Relations Executives provides assistance to guests on a wide scope of needs, from routine tasks such as opening a bank account and familiarizing guests with the neighbourhood to organizing personalized tours of the city, interest classes and festive celebrations. Personalized care: dedication Four Seasons style. The following services are available: 24-hour multilingual concierge; 24-hour in-room dining; 24-hour laundry; Dry-cleaning and pressing; Self-service laundry room; Limousine; Baby-sitting; A pillow menu with a choice of down and non-allergenic pillows. Guests can retreat to the Spa at the adjacent Four Seasons Hotel — 16 treatment rooms including two lavish spa suites. Programmes from massages and body treatments to facial treatments, yoga, Pilates and tai chi classes.

LOCATION & TRANSPORT. Four Seasons Place is an integral part of the ifc complex offering convenience second to none. ifc is an international landmark and prestigious Hong Kong development including grade-A offices for major multinational companies and the up-scale ifc mall with shopping, gourmet dining and the finest entertainment. Four Seasons Place is directly above the main interchange of the Airport Express and MTR. Proximity to the cross-harbour Star Ferry and ferries to outlying islands, a public bus and minibus terminus, taxi stands, ample parking in the complex and a covered walkway connecting the entire Central business district offer a huge array of options.

DINING & ENTERTAINMENT. At the push of an elevator button, guests of Four Seasons Place are at the doorstep of ifc: a premier complex offering numerous dining and entertainment choices in ifc mall and the Four Seasons Hotel. ifc is home to some of the world's most celebrated restaurants, including Michelin-rated ones, and it also has over 200 up-market international retailers and a five-screen cinema. Just a ten-minute walk from Four Seasons Place is Lan Kwai Fong and SoHo. For cultural activities guests can walk to City Hall or take the cross-harbour ferry to the Cultural Centre in Tsim Sha Tsui. The Hong Kong Central Promenade is a short walk away.

OFFICIAL FAQ (fsphk.com). What defines Four Seasons Place as the leading luxury serviced apartment in Hong Kong? As a premier luxury hotel serviced apartment in Central Hong Kong, Four Seasons Place offers an unparalleled living experience. Located atop the ifc complex in Central, our residences combine the comforts of home with the legendary service of Four Seasons. Which room type does Four Seasons Place offer? Four Seasons Place offers 519 serviced furnished apartments in Central Hong Kong, ranging from Studio, 1-Bedroom, 2-Bedroom and 3-Bedroom Suites to Penthouse options. Does Four Seasons Place accept short-term stays of less than a month? Absolutely. In addition to traditional monthly leasing, we warmly welcome Short Stays of just a few days or Weekly Stays. Are the rooms furnished? All rooms are thoughtfully designed as luxury serviced apartments, each furnished with fully-equipped kitchenette including a full-size refrigerator; dishwasher; 2-in-1 washer-dryer unit; microwave with grill or with oven function etc. (Dishwasher is available in 1-bedroom suite & above). What is inclusive in monthly rental? The rate is inclusive of management fee, government rates, electricity, water supply, air-conditioning, local calls, kitchenette, housekeeping and linen change service, 24-hour concierge, access to pool and gym on 59/F. For direct booking, there will be no commission nor agency nor transaction fees applied. There are no other hidden charges. What payment methods does Four Seasons Place accept? Cheque or bank transfer. Deposit is required for all monthly bookings and will be refunded to the guest within 30 days after check-out. What privileges can guest enjoy? Bespoke discounts and exclusive benefits for selected restaurants in Four Seasons Hotel: Argo, Lung King Heen, The Lounge, as well as at ifc mall: Sabatini Ristorante Italiano & Shikigiku Japanese Restaurant etc.

name: Pacific Place Apartments
tagline: Swire’s 268 fully serviced Admiralty residences, 1,220 to 2,650 sq ft, with Guest Experience by The Upper House.
description:
PACIFIC PLACE APARTMENTS (official Swire Properties portfolio page).

As part of the Pacific Place complex, PACIFIC PLACE APARTMENTS offers refined and spacious serviced residences at a highly accessible and convenient location.

Residential. Featuring 268 one-, two- and three-bedroom fully serviced suites ranging from 1,220 sq ft to 2,650 sq ft in size, PACIFIC PLACE APARTMENTS offers an exceptional living experience in one of Hong Kong's most vibrant urban districts.

PACIFIC PLACE APARTMENTS provides personalised concierge and security services managed by Swire Properties. Additionally, it offers complimentary access to the health and fitness facilities at the adjoining Conrad Hong Kong, which include an outdoor swimming pool and a 24-hour fitness centre. Leases are available for a minimum of one month.

At a Glance. Size: 268 serviced residences ranging in size from 1,220 to 2,650 sq ft. Accessibility: Connected to Admiralty MTR station through the Pacific Place development. Services: Multilingual Guest Experience service, security and housekeeping, 7 days a week. Facilities: Outdoor swimming pool and a 24-hour fitness centre.

Address published by Swire Properties: Pacific Place, 88 Queensway, Hong Kong. (852) 3515 6565. www.upperhouse.com/hongkong/pacific-place-apartments/

UPPER HOUSE — Pacific Place Apartments. Generously sized with captivating views, our fully-serviced apartments are beautifully designed homes with views of tranquil greenery or Victoria Harbour.

ONE-BEDROOM SUITES. A quiet haven rising above Admiralty district with ample space to enjoy the views from. With five optimised layouts designed for different lifestyles, each quiet one-room haven offers captivating views from above the bustle of Hong Kong's Admiralty district. Details at a glance: beds 1 King, 2 Twin; occupancy 3; room size 1,200-1,300 sq.ft.

TWO-BEDROOM SUITES. Expansive abode with foyer, separate kitchen and dining areas, and sweeping views. With walk-in wardrobes, sizeable kitchen pantry and sweeping views of Victoria Harbour or lush greenery, our two-bedroom suites are the perfect home for a family of four.

THREE-BEDROOM SUITES. Bright and expansive with a large kitchen, separate study and three bathrooms. A stunning home with amenities to match, our three-bedroom suite includes a large kitchen, three bathrooms, master bedroom with separate office space, and a generous living area for relaxing and hosting.

Services & Amenities. With our multilingual and expertly informed Guest Experience team, and a full range of housekeeping services seven days a week to keep your homes well maintained, exceptional round-the-clock convenience comes as standard.

Facilities. Complimentary membership for adjoining Conrad Hong Kong's health and leisure facilities, including: Outdoor swimming pool; 24-hour fitness centre.

Pet-Friendly Residence. Each suite welcomes up to one fully-vaccinated fur family member under 15kg.

Flexibility Meets Comfort. Stay for a month or stay forever in the comfort of your home in the heart of the city.

Enquiry. For more details or viewing arrangements, please contact us on +852 3515 6565 or at ppaleasing@swirehotels.com.

FIND US. Pacific Place, 88 Queensway, Admiralty, Hong Kong. +852 3968 1000.

Resident voices published on the official suite pages: “When I moved here from New York, Admiralty felt like Manhattan to me. Pacific Place Apartments was my first home in Hong Kong.” — Finance Executive, from the United States, resident of over 4 years. “We are in the heart of the city, everything is very very close. We are walking distance into Central and Soho.” — Housewife, from India, a resident since 2009. “Nothing comes close to the convenience and comfort of Pacific Place Apartments. This has really become my home away from home.” — Senior Vice President of banking services, from the United States, resident of over 3 years.

name: K11 ARTUS
tagline: Asia’s first artisanal home at Victoria Dockside — 510 sq.ft studios to 3,703 sq.ft penthouses above K11 MUSEA.
description:
K11 ARTUS is Asia’s first artisanal home concept for global cultural creatives, offering an ultra-luxury home living experience at the pulsating heart of Hong Kong, with breathtaking views over Victoria Harbour. Located above K11 MUSEA, the cultural-retail complex, K11 ARTUS’ residents enjoy the convenience of being in the heart of Victoria Dockside, the art and design district on the Tsim Sha Tsui waterfront.

BRAND BRIEF. An amalgam of the words 'Art' and 'Domus', Latin for 'Home', K11 ARTUS offers an artisanal living space for world travelers and cultural creatives.

Luxuriate in Modern Comfort Living. Experience the true expression of artisanal home at K11 ARTUS, with personalised luxury hotel services in a serviced apartment, making it a perfect retreat from the hustle and bustle in Hong Kong.

Luxury Hotel Residences. In a city where privacy and space are highly prized but rarely available, K11 ARTUS raises the bar. With 80% of our hotel residences offering luxuriously large spaces and wrap-around balconies, the utmost comfort is guaranteed.

STUDIO. The ultimate urban hideaway for short stays, perfectly suited to individuals and couples. The perfect urban hideaway for short stays, our luxurious Studio Residences feature open-plan living areas with floor-to-ceiling doors that lead to a spacious private balcony, an ideal spot to bask in either the spectacular Victoria Harbour vistas or the dynamic cityscape. This luxury studio room also boasts a semi-open kitchen, a spacious king-sized bed, and a walk-in closet for an indulging living experience. Our studio room’s luxurious semi-open kitchen comes fully equipped with an oven, a microwave, and a wide range of kitchen appliances and equipment from Miele, Gorenje, DeLonghi, and more. Enjoy an amazing cooking experience during your stay. *VR and images are for reference only. Same category residences are each uniquely configured and may not fully correspond to the actual unit assigned.

ARTUS STUDIO — Situated on the 8th to 16th floor of K11 ARTUS and with an area of 510-533 sqft., this luxury studio room comes fully equipped with a semi-open kitchen, king-sized bed, walk-in closet, and private balcony with an amazing city view. Enjoy free Wi-Fi and a wide range of complimentary in-room entertainment during your stay.

Grand ARTUS STUDIO — Situated on the 8th to 16th floor of K11 ARTUS and with an area of 611-687 sqft., this luxury studio room is also fully equipped with a semi-open kitchen, king-sized bed, walk-in closet, and private balcony that offers an amazing city view.

HARBOUR STUDIO — Situated on the 8th to 16th floor of K11 ARTUS and with an area of 519-720 sqft., this luxury studio room offers stunning views of Hong Kong’s Victoria Harbour from its living space, bathroom, and private balcony.

ONE-BEDROOM RESIDENCE. A generously proportioned residence ideal for individuals or couples looking for a more spacious Artisanal Home. Generously proportioned One-Bedroom Residences feature an open-plan living area with floor-to-ceiling doors leading to a private balcony, the perfect spot from which to soak up spectacular vistas across Victoria Harbour or dynamic city views. Boasting a fully equipped semi-open kitchen, king-sized bed, and walk-in closet, these artisanal one-bedroom suites are perfect for individuals or couples looking for a more spacious residence and a wonderfully comfortable stay.

ARTUS ONE — 8th to 16th floor, 799-1,245 sqft., city view balcony. HARBOUR ONE — 8th to 16th floor, 730-855 sqft., Victoria Harbour from bedroom, living room, bathroom and private balcony. GRAND HARBOUR ONE — 8th to 16th floor, 946-962 sqft., Victoria Harbour views.

ONE-BEDROOM PLUS STUDY ROOM. A thoughtfully designed luxury hotel residence for small families, with light-filled living and dining areas that allow for both private and semi-private space. Official residences listing: ARTUS One Plus 954-1,245 sq.ft; Harbour One Plus 880-962 sq.ft; Grand Harbour One Plus 1,051-1,272 sq.ft.

TWO-BEDROOM RESIDENCE. A truly luxurious home from home that acts as the perfect urban base for a family or travelling group. Two-Bedroom Residences feature an open-plan living area and an expansive private balcony that affords panoramic harbour or city views, whilst a private lift lobby and individual anteroom for units above 18/F deliver additional seclusion and security. These two-bedroom suites also come fully equipped with semi-open kitchens, king-sized beds & twin beds, and walk-in closets. ARTUS Horizon Collection: rare layout defined by ultra-high ceilings; generous private balcony with sweeping views of Victoria Harbour. ARTUS TWO 965-1,441 sqft. — semi-open kitchen, king-sized bed, twin bed, walk-in closets, two bathrooms, city view balcony. HARBOUR TWO 965-1,378 sqft. — continuous balcony connecting to the bedrooms, Victoria Harbour view.

THREE-BEDROOM RESIDENCE. A seamless wrap-around balcony with a 270-degree panoramic harbour view elevates this luxury hotel residence to new heights of peace and privacy. Three-Bedroom Residences offer unparalleled 270-degree panoramic harbour views, with an expansive balcony accessible from its living room and each of its bedrooms. Perfect for larger groups and families alike, this residence offers guests their very own front-row seats for Hong Kong's famed fireworks displays. ARTUS THREE 1,895 sqft. HARBOUR THREE 1,653-1,921 sqft.

PENTHOUSE ONE. Designed by award-winning British interior designer and entrepreneur Fiona Barratt-Campbell and her studio Fiona Barratt Interiors. Residence size 3,703 sq.ft. “A successful interior should enhance, not dictate, the way you live.”

PENTHOUSE TWO. Designed by award-winning New York architecture and design firm nemaworkshop, led by principal Anurag & Kevin Lien. Residence size 3,042 sq.ft.

PENTHOUSE THREE. Designed by renowned Hong Kong interior designer Joyce Wang, Penthouse 3 is a luxury hotel residence that celebrates creative individuality. Residence size 3,464 sq.ft.

In-residence fittings published on studio / one- / two- / three-bedroom and penthouse pages: King-sized bed; Walk-in closet; Continuous balcony; Fully equipped semi-open kitchen (cooking ware, microwave oven, fridge, kettle, toaster, coffee machine, and electronic induction stove); In-room safe; Washer & dryer combo; Extra-wide living room; 49” TV with sound bar (local & international channels, AppleTV, Netflix, Chromcast). Two-bedroom and above also: Twin bed. Three-bedroom and penthouses also: Wine cellar; Dishwasher.

RESIDENCE FACILITIES (official wellness page). The Living Salon — Flanked by sinuous walls on one side and the iconic Victoria Harbour on the other, our art-filled salon pays tribute to Hong Kong's rich cultural legacy. 10th Floor. 24 hours. +852 2107 3388. A private lounge of lush succulents and palms with seating arranged in intimate groups amid polished brass and marble flooring.

The Pool — Spectacularly clad in turquoise Balinese stone, our 25-metre outdoor infinity pool offers the epitome of serenity through architecture. 11th Floor. OPERATION HOURS 07:00-19:00. SUMMER OPERATION HOURS (Jul to Sep) 07:00-20:00. The magnificent outdoor terrace and a spectacular 25m outdoor infinity pool allow you to gaze over the city.

The Gym — Offering motivating harbourside views that open your horizons, our self-serviced gym is a sanctuary for mindful relaxation and rejuvenating fitness. 11th Floor. 24 hours.

The Library — With an impactful seven-metre high ceiling, our library space draws the eye to uninterrupted Victoria Harbour vistas, and the mind to the intellectual treasures within. 10th & 11th Floor. 24 hours.

Dine. An urban sanctuary inspired by the calm of Victoria Harbour serving familiar favourites. Victoria Café.

name: Rosewood Residences Hong Kong
tagline: 186 ultra-luxury studios, apartments and duplexes above Victoria Harbour, with Club 53 and Rosewood service.
description:
Rosewood Residences. Where style meets comfort. Dramatic views of Kowloon Peak.

Soaring high above Victoria Harbour, Rosewood Residences offers 186 beautifully appointed ultra-luxury studios, apartments and duplexes for extended stays. Melding exquisite form with modern comfort, Rosewood Hong Kong’s lofty residences comprise 186 ultra-luxury studios, one- and two-bedroom apartments, and three-bedroom duplexes.

For those seeking a similarly refined extended stay experience with a distinct artistic flair, our sister property K11 ARTUS, located at Victoria Dockside, offers 287 residences part of the Rosewood Hong Kong complex, blending curated design with sweeping harbour views.

Featured Services & Amenities (official residences page): Perfectly designed for extended stays; Fully equipped kitchenette with Miele appliances; Daily housekeeping services (except Sundays and Public Holidays); Club 53 lifestyle lounge; Indoor heated swimming pool; 24-hour multi-function fitness studios; Complimentary use of in-house laundry room; Priority reservations at Asaya integrative wellness, hotel restaurants and bars; Pet-friendly; Parking on application upon request.

Apartment offerings.

STUDIO. With a dedicated private entrance, luxury Studios offer fuss-free comfort and bespoke services to longer staying guests. The Studio features a fully-equipped kitchen and luxurious interiors in a compact, yet invitingly spacious setting. A private entrance unveils bespoke comforts and a fully-equipped kitchen within this invitingly spacious retreat. Official studio page: Perfectly designed for extended stays; Fully-equipped kitchenette with Miele appliances; WiFi; 55-inch television & Bose sound system; Marble bathroom with deep soaking tub, shower & washlet; Bespoke selection of bedding & electrical amenities; Complimentary movies on-demand; Daily housekeeping (except Sundays & Public Holidays); Bellmen; 24-hour in-room dining; 24-hour fitness studios; Changing rooms with lockers & steam room; Complimentary use of the in-house laundry room; Pet-friendly property.

PREMIUM STUDIO. Premium Studios provide elevated luxury living that is unrivalled in the city. Corner units offer private outdoor terraces for expansive views of the Hong Kong skyline. Guest services include exclusive lifestyle facilities at Club 53.

ONE-BEDROOM. Accessed by private lift, the generous One-Bedrooms showcase cocooned privacy for longer stays in the city. Design features are subtly layered with chic finishes and elegant detailing. The bedroom allows for privacy and flexible living.

PREMIUM ONE-BEDROOM. Sophisticated touches distinguish the Premium One-Bedrooms. Corner units offer 270-degree panoramic views of Victoria Harbour with the choice of having an outdoor terrace. Guest services include exclusive lifestyle facilities at Club 53. Official page: Revel in refined elegance and harbour vistas. Exclusive Club 53 access elevates your stay. Also listed: 55-inch television & Bose sound system; WiFi; Marble bathroom with deep soaking tub, shower & washlet; In-room washer & dryer; Changing rooms with lockers & steam room.

TWO-BEDROOM. The Two-Bedroom units truly convey an elevated home-away-from-home. With private lift access, the luxurious estate concept is brought to life with refined, thoughtful design, stylistically pared-down interior details and spacious areas.

The Rosewood Difference. Enjoy access to a myriad of ultra-luxury services. CLUB 53 — Step through the doors of the dedicated elevators that service Rosewood Residences to discover the splendour of Club 53. DISTINCTIVE LUXURY LIVING — Elevate your stay in the city with VIP access to the hotel’s many amenities and a private club floor with lifestyle and wellness facilities. IMPECCABLE SERVICE — Enjoy unparalleled attention to detail and an extensive program of personalized services, bespoke amenities and exclusive privileges. EXQUISITE DINING EXPERIENCES — Modern interpretations of Hong Kong’s unique culinary heritage are enjoyed across eight outlets and bars with terraced settings overlooking the water.

OFFICIAL ROSEWOOD RESIDENCES FACT SHEET. About: With 186 luxury accommodations perfectly designed for ultra-residential extended stays, Rosewood Hotel & Residences Hong Kong offers a range of units from superlative studios to three-bedroom duplexes, all with peerless harbour and city views. Generous in form and detail, warm, sophisticated interiors incorporate curated design with function. Location: Conveniently situated on the Kowloon harbourfront, on a historic site where the city’s future as a global trading hub was first established, and framed within the ambitious landmark of Victoria Dockside arts, culture and luxury retail district, the Rosewood Residences is connected to Hong Kong Island by fast, convenient water, road, MTR, and Star Ferry transfers. Direct link to MTR station; Star Ferry: 5-minute walk; China Ferry Terminal: 3 minutes by car; Kai Tak Cruise Terminal: 20 minutes by car; Airport Express: 10 minutes by car; Airport: 30 minutes by car.

Long-stay Accommodations. Light-filled spaces abound, with plunging views onto the sparkling harbour designed by renowned, visionary hospitality designer Tony Chi, of New York studio tonychi. Chi has created a complete experience for a new era of differentiated, elevated residential living that includes elegantly appointed apartments, leafy private gardens and picturesque verdant terraces for a handful of select units. Showcasing unmatched water, Hong Kong Island and Kowloon Peak mountain views, Rosewood Residence’s 186 self-contained apartments boast spacious, meticulously designed luxury at every turn. The array of Rosewood Residences Hong Kong apartments ranges from 44-square-metre (474-square-foot) studios, to statuesque one-bedroom apartments starting at 74 square metres (797 square feet) in size and transitioning to two-bedroom apartments starting at 109 square metres (1,173 square feet) in size. Four stunningly appointed two-storey duplex “houses” are located on the 64th floor of the Rosewood Tower, each with its own unique and spellbinding aspect, characteristics and amenities, as well as the finest finishing and designer accessorising. These standout living spaces boast sumptuous leather-clad walls, floors and ornamental shelving on each of their private staircases.

Exclusive Private Lounge Concept. Rosewood Residences’ guests enter through a private lobby at ground level on Salisbury Road, before stepping into elevators that transport them to Club 53, Rosewood Residences’ spacious private lounge concept. Here, in this ultra-luxurious retreat with an array of carefully curated lifestyle amenities, guests can enjoy the expansive full-service offerings of a 24-hour private club, and simply choose to collect their mail, stop to sip a coffee and have a snack, or go for a workout, enjoy a swim, or transition to the elevators to take them to their studio apartment, with one-bedroom units and above having their own semi-private elevator directly into the apartments. In Club 53’s warm, cocooning surrounds, guests can enjoy concierge service 24 hours a day, while cosying up to a good book, working remotely, or helping themselves to a light breakfast or all-day homemade snacks from the well-stocked pantry. An accent on well-being is highlighted throughout — in the spacious, state-of-the-art fitness centre, or for workouts with a personal trainer in the standalone PT studio. An additional yoga studio flanking the heated indoor pool is also set up for TRX training. Here, roasted coffee is available on tap, while water and healthful snacks can be enjoyed alongside a relaxing dip in the marble, heated lap pool or while luxuriating on the designer sun-loungers in this light-flooded space surrounded by glittering views of Victoria Harbour. A plentiful programme of well-being activities such as group yoga, personal training sessions and fitness activities engage the mind, body and spirit.

description:
Luxury Apartments for Rent in Hong Kong | The Repulse Bay.

A sophisticated oasis on Hong Kong's South Side, The Repulse Bay provides luxury serviced and unfurnished apartments for those seeking an idyllic lifestyle. Owned and operated by The Hongkong and Shanghai Hotels, Limited, The Repulse Bay offers a glamorous lifestyle with the convenience of a bustling city.

With panoramic ocean views and just 15 minutes from the city, The Repulse Bay brings together seaside calm and urban convenience. Built for every stage of life, it offers spacious residences, curated services, and resort-style living in a tranquil enclave.

SERVICED APARTMENTS. The Repulse Bay raises the bar for Hong Kong serviced apartments with exquisite finishes, contemporary custom furnishings and exhilarating sea views. Each luxury apartment offers flexible short-term leasing options as well as cleaning, linen and valet laundry services for your convenience.

de Ricou Serviced Apartments. Bathed in natural light, The Repulse Bay’s de Ricou luxury serviced apartments offer 1,735 to 3,409 sq ft of sophisticated style and practical comfort in both simplex and duplex layouts, designed to seamlessly balance shared living with personal privacy for multi-generational families. Contemporary, custom-designed furnishings, along with curated art and thoughtful details, create a refined, move-in-ready home, with flexible short-term leases available.

MOMENTS OF RELAXATION. Lavishly finished with pristine marble, the bathroom has room for two to prepare side by side at the large vanity for an evening out, or to relax in the deep-soak tub for an evening in.

PANORAMIC VISTAS. These luxury serviced apartments offer space and light in abundance, with sweeping views of the South China Sea from expansive floor-to-ceiling windows and calming neutral tones throughout.

A TRANQUIL RETREAT. The contemporary design of the spacious bedrooms flows seamlessly with superb sea views, offering an airy, serene sanctuary.

SPACES THAT INSPIRE. Sleek, modern and uncluttered, the open kitchen offers ample space to prepare meals and is equipped with appliances from respected international brands.

Official published layouts on the de Ricou serviced apartments page: Two-Bedroom Simplex — 1,735 sq ft to 1,805 sq.ft. (Gross). Three-Bedroom with Study Duplex — 3,370 sq.ft. to 3,465 sq. ft. (Gross). Official 360 panorama: https://www.aralphabet.com/therepulsebay/t101.html

PRICE & AVAILABILITY (official de Ricou page). Unit 02. Gross Area (sq.ft.) 1,737 – 1,806. Saleable Area (sq.ft.) 1,302 – 1,313. Monthly Rent (inclusive) HK$96,000 up. Monthly Mgt. Fee Inclusive. Quarterly Govt. Rates Inclusive. Terms 1 month up.

UNFURNISHED APARTMENTS (official landing). An elegant blank canvas to express your own style. Create your own serene sanctuary with a spacious unfurnished apartment. This oceanview home is available in single- and two-story apartments with flexible layouts that offer more space and privacy, along with panoramic views of the shimmering South China Sea. Floor-to-ceiling windows and spacious balconies open onto spectacular views of the South China Sea. Flexible layouts ranging from three to four bedrooms, plus a study and a helper's room, suit families of all sizes and generations.

RESIDENT FACILITIES AND SERVICES. The Repulse Bay offers a serene seaside setting that fosters a welcoming community where everyone can enjoy resort living while staying connected. The Arcade brings everyday convenience closer to home, while The Club offers luxurious indoor and outdoor facilities and fun community events.

THE CLUB. Explore a wide range of lifestyle and fitness facilities at The Club, where residents gather to work out, meet new friends or just relax and have fun. Discover the comprehensive lifestyle and fitness facilities at The Club, with 60,000 sq ft of space and state-of-the-art equipment, catering to a thriving community. Welcome to The Club, where state-of-the-art fitness facilities, curated wellness classes for kids, adults, and seniors, and exceptional service help you stay active and feel your best. The Club offers spacious courts for tennis, squash, table tennis, and pickleball, with classes for adults and children. With classes and workshops for all ages, covering more than 20 areas of interest, The Repulse Bay Club lets you explore your potential and develop a healthy lifestyle. Complimentary family membership at The Club with indoor and outdoor swimming pools and a fitness centre.

Overlooking breathtaking views of the South China Sea, our pool and outdoor amenities provide a serene space to unwind, recharge and embrace the best of seaside living. Exclusively for residents, the outdoor resort pool offers panoramic views while sunbathing on the deck.

THE ARCADE. The Arcade brings everyday essentials to your doorstep, from grocery shopping and boutique retail outlets to a bookstore, an art studio, healthcare facilities, laundry service and more, building a carefree lifestyle for all ages. Find everything you need here, from a gourmet supermarket, restaurants, lifestyle amenities, art shops and medical clinics. Dining: The Verandah, Spices, Bamboo Bar, Arcade Dining. 20% discount on food and beverages at The Verandah and Spices.

PET-FRIENDLY. The Repulse Bay welcomes every member of the family, including pets. Lush green spaces and landscaped surroundings provide a calm, natural setting for relaxed moments together in this pet-friendly community.

SHUTTLE. Daily shuttle bus services between The Repulse Bay and Central (15 minutes) / Ocean Park MTR Station (5 minutes). Enjoy convenient access between The Repulse Bay, Central, and Ocean Park with our dedicated shuttle bus service. The property is also accessible for student buses from nearby international schools. Please be aware that service may be suspended in the event of a Typhoon Signal No. 8 or above, or a black rain storm warning.

RESIDENTS’ PRIVILEGES / AMENITIES & MANAGEMENT (official list): Daily shuttle bus services between The Repulse Bay and Central (15 minutes) / Ocean Park MTR Station (5 minutes); Exclusive access to a secure covered car park with a parking space included; 24-hour security team with CCTV system and security controlled entrances; Owned and managed by The Hongkong & Shanghai Hotels, Limited, owner and operator of The Peninsula Hotels; Complimentary family membership at The Club with indoor and outdoor swimming pools and a fitness centre; 20% discount on food and beverages at The Verandah and Spices; Close proximity to prestigious international schools with safe and secure school bus pick-up and drop-off; Smoke and heat detectors installed and connected to fire alarm system to ensure fire safety; In-house Estate Management & Engineering team support; Large gourmet supermarket and medical centre at The Arcade at your doorstep; TRBChat — a dedicated, one-stop e-concierge service to take care of all your needs; Hotel accommodation and restaurant privileges from The Peninsula Hotels; LEED system (Leadership in Energy and Environmental Design) certified; Kitchens comprehensively equipped with appliances from respected international brands; Bathrooms luxuriously finished with stone of the highest quality and environmentally friendly low-discharge showers; Satellite and cable TV with multiple international channels and reception for local digital HD TV signals.

SOUTHSIDE LIVING. The Southside neighbourhood is home to pristine beaches and verdant trees in an iconic location that embraces both urban dynamism and natural beauty. Some of the world’s most beautiful hiking trails are available on your doorstep.

Welcome to Lanson Place — a sanctuary of warmth, attentiveness and style nestled in the heart of Hong Kong's vibrant Causeway Bay. Recently redesigned by award-winning French interior designer Pierre-Yves Rochon, it's the perfect place to relax, recharge and truly feel at home.

Your sanctuary in the heart of vibrant Causeway Bay. Leave the hustle and bustle behind and step into a place that feels like home. A sanctuary of serenity and French-inspired sophistication. A place to pause, connect and reconnect. Your place, that’s Lanson Place.

An iconic luxury hotel in Causeway Bay, Hong Kong, Lanson Place offers a serene sanctuary for avid travellers and provides a mindful and restful stay.

Your Place to Retreat. Immerse yourself in an oasis of quiet luxury designed by French master of luxury Pierre-Yves Rochon, blending understated French elegance and residential calm in the heart of Causeway Bay.

Your Place to Belong. Here, you are truly understood. Discover genuine warmth, intuitive service and a sense of belonging that makes you feel at home from the moment you arrive.

Your Place to Wander. From our thoughtfully curated spaces to the storied streets just beyond our doors, this is your invitation to slow down, embrace the local way of life and explore the unique spirit of the neighbourhood.

Your Place to Dream. From a short business trip to a well-deserved holiday, this is your stylish sanctuary in the heart of vibrant Causeway Bay. Our spacious rooms seamlessly blend ingenious designs with intricate craftsmanship, creating a home away from home.

Designed with French sophistication and guest comfort in mind, our long-stay room types range from 450 to 2,000 square feet, offering ample space and an elegant sanctuary where you can live, work and rest as you would at home. With various configurations from open-plan layouts to suites, all long-stay residences feature daylight-flooded spaces through oversized windows that capture uninterrupted views of the city.

Thoughtful Amenities for Homelike Comfort. Each long-stay room and suite is furnished with a fully equipped kitchenette, including an induction cooker, microwave oven and minibar. Our Serviced Suites are crafted to the highest standards of luxury, offering an exclusive living environment for an opulent stay. The themed floors enhance this experience with unique designs that reflect elegance and comfort.

Guests have full access to Parkview’s private club, featuring diverse recreational facilities for all ages. Enjoy fitness centers, indoor/outdoor swimming pools, themed play areas, and a variety of dining options—all at your fingertips.

Experience the ultimate blend of sophistication, fun, and tranquility at Hong Kong Parkview, where every stay is exceptional.

CONNECTING SUITE. 6 guests. 3 Bedroom. 2,010 ft². Perfectly suited for relocating families, these spacious and elegantly-appointed three-bedroom luxury serviced apartments cater up to six guests and offer 2,010 sqft (186 sqm.) of living space. With three bathrooms and double the kitchen space, these luxurious apartments are brilliant for entertaining and the inter-connecting suites mean privacy for every member of the family. From $149,000 to $164,000. Room Features / Guest Services (connecting-suite page): Club Membership; Maid service; Satellite & NOW TV; Bathroom amenities; Fully Equipped kitchenette with tableware; In-room Nespresso machine; Washer & Dryer; In-room safety box; Linen Supplies; Complimentary WiFi; Concierge service; 24-hour security; Parking Space; Free access to PressReader for online newspapers and magazines. FAMILY SUITE. 5 guests. 2 Bedroom. 1,320 ft². Ideal for smaller families, these two-bedroom suites are 1,320 sqft (122 sqm) and easily catered up to five guests. Hong Kong Parkview's two-bedroom Executive Suites are ideal for both business travellers looking for space and privacy, and families looking for a convenient home-away-from-home. tagline: Three houses in Tai Hang — Corner House, Lane House and Garden House — hotel stays and serviced apartments from 358 sq ft gross studios to 1,026 sq ft two-beds.
description:
LITTLE TAI HANG HOTEL AND SERVICED APARTMENTS — CAUSEWAY BAY / TIN HAU / TAI HANG.

Official homepage: A Welcoming place to stay… Little Tai Hang service a cluster of three beautifully designed buildings in the heart of Hong Kong’s most authentic neighborhoods. OUR BUILDINGS: The Corner House; The Lane House; The Garden House. A Neighbourhood full of charm, a brand full of character, and A VIEW TO remember.

STAY WITH US — HOTEL BOOKING. Just in town for few days? With all the prime locations within reach, but a distinctly charming and “off the beaten track” atmosphere to our neighbourhood, Little Tai Hang is the best spot for a short getaway. Check rates and availability, and receive instant confirmation.

STAY WITH US — SERVICED APARTMENT. Looking for a home away from home and an exquisitely charming neighbourhood to explore? Send us an email or call direct on + 852 3899 8800 to let us know your requirements to ensure we reserve the most suitable apartment for you.

THE CORNER HOUSE — STUDIO STANDARD GARDEN VIEW (official room page). The design centric 358 sq.ft., open plan is ideal for savvy travelers. This unit has a serene mountain view that brings plenty of natural sunlight in the mornings. Located in a quaint and peaceful corner of Tai Hang, yet only a few steps away from one of the busiest districts in Hong Kong. Top it off with a bird’s eye view of the local temple and bamboo park, and you have everything you’ll need for an unforgettable trip. 358 SQ.FT. GROSS. Features: Complimentary Wi-Fi access; Individual air-conditioning control; Double size bed; Bathroom amenities set* & hairdryer; Apple TV; Welcome goodies*; Iron & iron board; Complimentary local phone calls; Simmons high quality mattress; Shower; International TV channels; Electronic kettle; Wine cooler; Electronic safe. *For daily stay, replenishment of bathroom amenities and welcome goodies, maid service and towel change are on daily basis.

THE CORNER HOUSE — STUDIO CORNER PARTIAL/HARBOUR VIEW (official room page). See one of Hong Kong’s most beautiful sights from the comforts of a Little Tai Hang studio. Catch a glimpse of the Hong Kong Harbour from the 409 square feet Studio Corner Harbour / Partial Harbour View room and see the sky come alive with the nightly lightshow. Imbued with thoughtful local touches and a decadent sunken bathtub to rest your weary bones, every stay at Little Tai Hang combines cultural flair and top of the line service for an accommodation experience unlike any other. With fantastic dining concepts located just downstairs and the charming Tai Hang neighbourhood, everything you’ll ever need is within arm’s reach. 409 SQ.FT. GROSS.

THE CORNER HOUSE — ONE BEDROOM LUXURY HARBOUR VIEW (official room page). As one of Little Tai Hang’s most premium tier options, our luxury one-bedroom offerings will provide you with a truly unforgettable experience. With both a luxury and deluxe luxury option available, our 730-802 square feet rooms offer two configurations: one with an ocean view living room and mountain view bedroom, and another with the opposite configuration. Both have generous pantry’s, in-built washer dryer, full dining areas included, and both allow you to enjoy the splendour of the tranquil mountain view and the magnificent harbour view together in one unit. With its generous size, broad open views, and lovingly designed details, units like these are few and far between in a place like Hong Kong. 730-802 SQ.FT. GROSS. Features include Complimentary Wi-Fi; Individual air-conditioning; Simmons mattress; Bathtub^; Washer/dryer^; Apple TV; Welcome goodies*; Electronic safe; Full Pantry & appliances; Complimentary local phone calls; Queen size bed; Shower; Bathroom amenities set* & hairdryer; International TV channels; Electronic kettle; Refrigerator; Iron & Iron board. ^ In selected rooms. * Every day replenishment of bathroom amenities, welcome goodies, maid service, and towel change for daily stays.

THE GARDEN HOUSE — ONE BEDROOM PREMIUM GARDEN VIEW (official room page). These units are located in the Garden house, the most private and secluded of our three houses. Positioned deeper into Lin Fa Kung Park and nestled in the mountainside, the views are full of lush greenery and park-front views. Another notable characteristic is its exclusivity as a one-room per floor building, with a dedicated foyer and luxurious, naturally lit bathroom with washer dryer. The floors are flush with darker natural timber, with a warmer and more rustic palette to the colors and finishes. Stay here for a private and serene getaway and a quiet respite from the din of bustling city life. 840 SQ.FT. GROSS. Features published: Complimentary Wi-Fi access; Complimentary local phone calls; Individual air-conditioning control; Queen size bed; Simmons high quality mattress; Bathtub.

THE LANE HOUSE — TWO BEDROOM DELUXE GARDEN VIEW (official room page). These units are located in the Lane house, positioned directly opposite the temple and overlooking Lin Fa Kung park. Every unit in this building is a spacious two bedroom with private foyer and washer dryer. Experience a close up view of the vibrant park and temple life, enjoy the expansive view of greenery and enjoy large swathes of sunlight at almost all hours of the day. The floors are flushed with darker natural timber, with a warmer and more rustic palette to the colors and finishes. This selection is perfect for you if you are travelling in groups or want to be placed right in the cultural heart of Tai Hang. 1026 SQ.FT. GROSS. Features published: Complimentary Wi-Fi access; Complimentary local phone calls; Individual air-conditioning control; Queen size bed and two single beds; Simmons high quality mattress; Shower.

SOPHISTICATED . LUXURIOUS . GLAMOROUS . INTERNATIONAL . TASTEFUL . COSMOPOLITAN

Serviced Apartments Hong Kong — Ascott North Point Hong Kong official site.

Nestled in the vibrant North Point district on Hong Kong Island, Ascott North Point Hong Kong boasts a prime location next to the iconic Victoria Harbour. The area around the serviced apartment is renowned for its rich cultural historical heritage, artistic flair and charming urban vibe. Enjoy a leisurely stroll along the picturesque seaside promenade, or explore the nearby Harbour North shopping mall featuring dining, entertainment and lifestyle options including supermarkets and other complementary facilities, which are within a short 300-metre walk. For those seeking for more, the trendy shopping malls and bustling business areas of Causeway Bay, Hong Kong Convention and Exhibition Centre, Central, Tsim Sha Tsui are just a quick 5-kilometre drive away. At Ascott North Point Hong Kong, experience a rare sense of leisure and tranquility amidst the fast-paced energy of Hong Kong.

Ascott North Point Hong Kong offers unparalleled convenience with North Point MTR station just a short 230-metre walk away. Residents can easily get around the city with a variety of transportation options such as ferries and iconic Hong Kong trams nearby.

Ascott North Point Hong Kong features 116 elegantly designed apartments, ranging from Standard Rooms to One-Bedroom Premier Suites. LANSON PLACE WATERFRONT SUITES — SEA VIEW SERVICED APARTMENT IN HK EASTERN DISTRICT. 1 OI TAK STREET, SHAU KEI WAN.

Official homepage: Book your extended stay at Lanson Place Waterfront Suites! Tucked in the vibrant eastern corner of Hong Kong Island, Lanson Place Waterfront Suites extends a warm welcome for those searching for a new home. Discover unparalleled comforts, easy access and community living in our peaceful escape. Book Now. Or simply call us at +852 2178 2288.

LIFE’S A BREEZE. Imagine waking up to the smell of freshly brewed coffee, savouring breakfast in the quiet lounge, and enjoying cocktails with neighbours when you return home. At Lanson Place Waterfront Suites, you can immerse yourself in unparalleled comforts in our peaceful escape. Indulge in one of the most coveted, by-the-sea serviced apartments in Hong Kong Island East.

OUR SPACES. Each of our apartments features a beautiful sea view and a balcony linking the outdoors seamlessly to the indoors. Our high ceilings (at 2.9 metres) and bespoke wood-rich fittings create a basic tonal palette and an original yet lofty look and feel. Enjoy elevated home-comforts in your new home-away-from-home on Hong Kong Island at Lanson Place Waterfront Suites.

Official homepage size bands (gross; both ft² and m² printed): 345–408ft² (32–38m²) Sea view; 526–573ft² (49–53m²) Sea view; 665–713ft² (61–66m²) Sea view; 622–706ft² (58–66m²) Sea view; 852–916ft² (79–85m²) Sea view; 949ft² (88m²) Sea view; 971ft² (90m²) Sea view; 1363ft² (127m²) Sea view. Booking widget: Minimum booking period is 30 nights.

STUDIO (official suites/studio page). Gross Area: 345–408ft² (32–38m²). Sea view. A great option for discerning travellers and short-term guests. Our studio apartment in Hong Kong Island East – with its upholstered floor-to-ceiling wall panel, marbled bathroom and corner kitchenette with an adjoined balcony – has a cosy and practical layout designed for those with a penchant for modern elegance. Room Layout: Entertain your guests with style and ease in our Studio apartment. Utilise the corner kitchenette and gather at the mini dining table while enjoying an open outdoor view through the balcony. Guests can enjoy the extra usable space with the under-bed storage. In the bathroom, our bespoke mirrored vanity unit and marbled-wall shower room add dimensions and a sense of lavishness. Room Amenities: Apple TV & SmartTV; High-speed fibre internet. Other In-Room Amenities: Iron & ironing board; Personal safe; Sealy mattress; Bathroom toiletries upon arrival. Kitchen Amenities: Siemens kitchen appliances; Panasonic rice cooker; Noritake and Bernardaud chinaware; Stolze glassware. Virtual tour published.

1-BEDROOM (official suites/1-bedroom page). Gross Area: 526–573ft² (49–53m²). Sea view. Sink into comfy splashes of Nordic cool in the apartment’s lofty, balconied living room. Revel in the harbour’s calmness as you laze in a bespoke sofa. Life’s a breeze in this perfect pied-à-terre designed for residence or longer-term travellers. Room Layout: Take in the peaceful Victoria Harbour view at the balcony or the bay window seat of our 1-bedroom apartment situated right by the famous waterfront. The large kitchenette-cum-dining area gives you the space to host cocktails and dinners with friends. In the airy bedroom, find plenty of storage space in the big wardrobe and relish the ample natural light from the adjoining balcony. Room Amenities add Washing & drying machine; Nespresso coffee machine and capsules; Bosch blender.

YOUR EXTENDED LIFESTYLE. Discover a world within Lanson Place Waterfront Suites. Relax or mingle at our range of functional and leisure facilities, each serving as an intimate extension of your personal space. Our devoted team is dedicated to perfecting every detail for that effortless and genuine comfort that reminds you fondly of home.

LOCATED IN HISTORICAL HONG KONG. Lanson Place Waterfront Suites is conveniently located in the vibrant Sai Wan Ho neighbourhood. Traverse the typhoon shelters, shopping mecca, heritage sites, and peaceful havens that make up the unique Hong Kong Island East. Discover Downtown Shau Kei Wan. Just a stone’s throw away from the bustling multinational business area and exciting nightlife of Quarry Bay… Shop at the gigantic Cityplaza, feast on gastronomic delights at SoHo East, and indulge your inner historical buff at the Hong Kong Museum of Coastal Defence. Address: Lanson Place Waterfront Suites, Hong Kong, 1 Oi Tak Street, Shau Kei Wan, Hong Kong.

Basic Services: Housekeeping twice a week; Bed linen & towel change once a week; 24-hour Concierge; 24-hour security and CCTV; Complimentary high speed WiFi (1GB); Daily complimentary grab-and-go breakfast and evening cocktails. Facilities: Outdoor wellness pool with BBQ and function area; Sun bath pressure jet; Gym’brary; Yo’garden; Self-service laundry. In-room: Siemens kitchenette; Noritake and Bernadaud chinaware and Stolze glassware; Apple TV and Bose bluetooth soundlink; iPad-controlled TV, lighting & gate access; 2-in-1 Siemens washer and dryer (except Studio); Nespresso; Wine cellar (selected). name: Chelsea Court
tagline: The Acme of Luxury Living at The Peak — sea-view simplexes 1,509–1,522 sq ft and 4-bedroom duplexes from 3,100 sq ft at 63 Mount Kellett Road.
description:
THE ACME OF LUXURY LIVING AT THE PEAK.

THE PINNACLE OF LUXURY LIVING. Perched majestically along Mount Kellett Road on the Peak - first and foremost the most coveted address in all of Hong Kong - Chelsea Court epitomises the prestige of this distinguished district. The beautifully designed development nestles in a secluded, serene neighbourhood in the lush hills of Mount Kellett, near scenic Pok Fu Lam Country Park.

With the horizon in full view, residents enjoy spectacular views of the glistening waters of the East Lamma Channel and South China Sea. The extensive windows frame the stunning vistas of the sea and sky's boundless beauty.

All apartments are furnished to an excellent standard. Main entrance, lift lobby and bathrooms are tastefully furbished with qualitied marble. The luxuriously spacious living and dining rooms features exceptionally generous, 11-ft high ceilings enhance the sense of scale in the apartment. The fully equipped kitchens are well-completed with premium-brand appliances including Gaggenau gas hobs and induction cooktops, Miele chimney-range hoods, microwaves, built-in fridge-freezers, ovens and dishwashers. Each duplex unit features with its exclusive balcony, garden or roof terrace. The spacious living area is extended to outdoor where are ideal for the little ones to play; friends and families to entertain. Direct access is provided to complimentary covered parking space in the LG/F car park via an electronically coded lift, in which the convenience, privacy and security of the residents are well preserved.

FACILITIES & SERVICES. One of the development's alluring features is a 20-m long lap pool overlooking the breathtaking panoramic seaview. Lying on the sun lounger along the expansive stone-paved sun terrace is ideal for cooling off after a swim or perfecting a tan.

Chelsea Court offers residents with sufficient carparking space. Each apartment allows direct access to its own complimentary covered parking space in the LG/F car park, complete with electronically coded lifts that guarantee tight security and privacy.

The entire property is professionally managed by Harriman Property Management Limited, offering 24-hour security and maintenance. The daily life of the residents are well taken care of.

FLOOR PLAN (official floor-plan page). Simplex — 1,509 to 1,522 sq ft; Bedroom: 2; View: Sea; Bathroom: 2. Published plans: Simplex House 1 - Flat A; Simplex House 1 - Flat B; Simplex House 2 - Flat A; Simplex House 2 - Flat B. 360 Viewer published for simplex.

Garden Duplex — 3,100 to 3,116 sq ft; 811 to 1,872 ft (Garden); Bedroom: 4; View: Sea; Bathroom: 4. Published plans: Garden Duplex House 1 - Flat A; Garden Duplex House 1 - Flat B; Garden Duplex House 2 - Flat A; Garden Duplex House 2 - Flat B. 360 Viewer published for garden duplex.

LOCATION & NEIGHBOURHOOD. Official address: 63 Mount Kellett Road, The Peak. Official location page groups nearby points as Shopping & Dining; Business & Commercial; Leisure & Nature; International Schools.

CONTACT. If you would like to experience the distinguished home in Chelsea Court, please complete the form below or contact us at our Leasing Hotline 2118 8048 for more information. Official monthly from-prices are not published. The official facilities page does not describe hotel-style housekeeping; this is a Peak residence under Harriman management.

COZY. VIBRANT. EXPERIENCE. THE MERCER — LUXURIOUS SERVICED APARTMENTS IN CENTRAL.

The Mercer Central is conveniently located within a transport hub that connects the Hong Kong-Macau Ferry Terminal, and Sheung Wan MTR Station, providing you with the perfect starting point for your journey. From here, Soho district is only a stone’s throw away, the vibrant area is bloomed with stylish restaurant, bars and art gallery. The heart of world-class offices – Central is only 5 mins walking distance away.

ACCOMMODATIONS. The Mercer offers 55 apartments that have everything you need for a comfortable stay. From the studio to one-bedroom, our suites are best for singles or couples looking for cozy and convenience experience.

1-BEDROOM EXECUTIVE. The urban 1-Bedroom Executive is generously equipped with a bedroom, work space, separate living and dining area, a spacious bathroom with combination of standing shower and bathtub, as well as an equipped modern pantry, giving you all the comforts of home in a hotel setting. Official colourways published on the accommodations page: Lagoona Blue; Pastel Pink.

STUDIO PREMIER. Bask in modish apartment living with the Studio Premier. Ideal for executives, this contemporary space comes equipped with a pantry, a living area, en-suite bathroom, and a working space.

STUDIO EXECUTIVE. By providing the most fundamental daily necessities to simplify your life. Bearing all the comforts for a single guest or a couple, the Studio Executive is ideally located for both business or travel purposes, each apartment comes with wireless Internet, air-conditioning and daily housekeeping. Official colourways published on the accommodations page: Irish Green; Lavender Rose.

FACILITIES — VIBRANT LIVING STYLE. The Mercer is more than a home, we offer difference facilities that cater all you need in your lives from daily needs, entertainment to work. There is a state-of-the-art gym facility and common launderette on site that provide all you need for accommodation and you can spend a whole day in on our deck to enjoy your life. Furthermore, we have a business Centre provide a great support for the guests who need to work from home.

THE GYMNASIUM. Keep up with your fitness regimes in our fully equipped gymnasium. Accessible 24 hours throughout the week.

THE DECK. Drop in whenever you want with 24/7 access, grab a seat in The Deck and step down the pace. Enjoy the peaceful moment in the dense city.

LAUNDRY SERVICES. We know you are busy and always on the go. Our 24-hour self-served launderette and dry cleaning service help keep your life easy, clean and tidy.

LOCAL ATTRACTIONS — EXPERIENCE THE CITY. The Mercer offers you the best location to discover from the aged traditions to the modern metropolis. With numerous dining options around, from traditional street snacks, nice cafes and fine dining.

STAY WITH US. Cozy home • The Mercer Central Hong Kong. Come and get the best rate from our web site.

tagline: Mid-Levels serviced suites from Garden/Skyline Room 336 sq.ft to The MacDonnell Suite 1,900 sq.ft, with café bar on 8 and 24-hour gym.
description:
An urban sanctuary blending the tranquillity of the Mid-levels, proximity to CBD, and expansive views of Central, Two MacDonnell Road affords accessible Island-side living for the discerning traveller.

The City’s Best Hidden Gem. Rediscover life as it should be with the best of urban-centre living amidst the lush, winding avenues of the tranquil Central Mid-levels. Whether doing your morning jog in the nearby Botanical Gardens or Hong Kong Park, dabbling in the night life of Lan Kwai Fong, or mingling with love ones and extended neighbours on our famous café bar on 8, you’ll always find yourself drawn back to Two MacDonnell Road, your home away from home.

Urban Sanctuary — Tastefully furnished rooms with breathtaking views of Hong Kong’s famous skyline, situated in a leafy, tranquil neighbourhood. Business Meets Lush — Work, play and indulge in Central and Mid-levels, where expansive greenery, vibrant nightlife, and Grade A offices stand shoulder to shoulder. Spaces to Mingle — Relax over a drink or casual meal, hold meetings and events, workout, or simply lounge – all on one single floor dedicated to vibrant social living.

Our Spaces. Reside in our unique, serviced apartment-style accommodations, each offering unfettered views of the city skyline, well-equipped with an open kitchen and the basic amenities for hassle-free living. Official space types with published sizes (homepage and official fact sheet): Garden/Skyline Room 336 sq.ft (30 sq.m), city/garden view — mirrored entryway, wide bay windows, open-plan design, queen bed; Standard/Superior Suite 470 sq.ft (43 sq.m), city view — separate living and sleeping spaces, dining table, kitchen amenities; Garden/Skyline Suite 560 sq.ft (52 sq.m) gross, queen bed, city/garden view — spacious one-bedroom suite with separate living and dining areas and an ensuite bathroom with a full bathtub; Garden Deluxe/Skyline Deluxe Suite 650 sq.ft (60 sq.m) gross, king bed, city/garden view — one-bedroom suite with a four-person dining table, an open kitchen, and a private desk space in the bedroom; Garden/Skyline Apartment 750 sq.ft (69 sq.m) gross, queen/double bed, city/garden view — master bedroom with queen bed and guest bedroom with double bed, wall-to-wall closets, full tub, full refrigerator and freezer in the open kitchen; The MacDonnell Suite 1,900 sq.ft (177 sq.m), city view — on the highest guest floor, 32 floors up, two-bedroom residence, spacious en-suite with bathtub and separate shower, large living area. Official MacDonnell Suite in-room list: full kitchen; washing & drying machine; Simmons® mattress; Aromatherapy Associates toiletries; bay window seat; LG 65″ smart TV; wireless broadband; voicemail and iDD telephone lines; in-room electronic safe; iron and ironing board (upon request); baby cot (upon request); master bathroom with switchable privacy glass film; bathtub and shower; Dyson hair dryer; microwave oven; refrigerator; electric stove and electric oven; wine cooler; electric kettle; utensils and cookware; Nespresso coffee machine. THE BAUHINIA APARTMENTS CENTRAL. THE 1ST BIPV BUILDING IN HK. WELCOME TO THE BAUHINIA — STEP INTO SERENITY.

Located in the heart of Central and Sheung Wan, the complex of hotel and serviced apartments stands beside Man Wa Lane, renowned for its traditional chop-making artisans. The apartment's new design concept is a tribute to this cultural heritage, incorporating stamp frame motifs while blending Eastern and Western aesthetics. The interplay of purple and gold tones creates an ambience of refined luxury, establishing the property as a distinctive landmark in Central's dynamic landscape. The hospitality project incorporates environmentally friendly technologies, including Building Integrated Photovoltaic (BIPV) technology adopted for one facade, which consists entirely of solar panels, significantly enhancing energy efficiency and aligning with the group’s commitment to sustainable development. name: The Luna
tagline: Oasis amid authentic urban living — Wan Chai, Hong Kong.
description:
The Luna is a luxury serviced apartments located in Wan Chai, the heart of Hong Kong. We offer residents maximum flexibility and comfort. Our 105 fully-furnished apartments offer diversified layouts for individuals and families with a discerning taste for living.

Building Concept. Beaming upon the kaleidoscopic neighbourhood in Wan Chai, The Luna stands for “Lunar”, illuminating the area with its unique and sleek architectural design. The name also echoes “Lun” in Lun Fat Street, where the project is located. You could almost hear the letterpress machines in motion at The Luna. The design by renowned London-based Make Architects is inspired by the letterpress printing history in the district. This significant neighbourhood of Wan Chai has constructed Hong Kong’s idiosyncratic culture with its letterpress printing industry, among other unique local businesses. Weaving the past into the future, The Luna transforms the skyline of this trendy neighbourhood for locals and expats. The lustrous metallic tower’s doubled-glazed curtain walls give a futuristic touch in its nostalgic spirit. Endorsing the bygone industry, the architecture features a striking printing block motif. The balconies on The Luna’s exterior are made of champagne gold aluminium cladding, resembling traditional metal printing blocks in letterpress printing. The essence of the district’s legendary industry is also embodied in letterpress-inspired sculptures inside the building. While retaining the traditional, The Luna embraces the unconventional yet never compromises functionality. It stands out predominantly from its concrete surroundings. Apartment balconies, in their square shape and gradual perforation, are staggered across all sides of the façade. The design offers changing views, while creating intriguing patterns of light and shadow when it is viewed from different angles. The windows at two ends of corridor invite abundant natural light and better ventilation. Want to escape from the hurly-burly? Grab a coffee, or chill with friends and family in the club lounge or work out at the outdoor gym in the clubhouse on the 3rd floor. The Luna is awarded “Best Serviced Apartment Provider” in 2019.

Apartments. The Luna is an expression of authentic urban living. Reliving the streetwise nature of the Wan Chai community, we offer residents maximum flexibility and comfort. Our 105 fully-furnished apartments offer diversified layouts for individuals and families with a discerning taste for living: Studio, One-Bedroom, Deluxe One-Bedroom, Two-Bedroom Units and Penthouse. Ranging from 365 to 1,771 square feet, each typical unit comes with at least one champagne gold balcony. Marvel at the iconic views of the Victoria Harbour and The Peak, the highest point on Hong Kong Island, from selective floors. Thanks to our signature doubled-glazed curtain walls, each apartment enjoys maximal space, view and natural light, in addition to thermal and sound insulation. Return to a homelike environment after a long day. Delight in cozy home cooking in the fully-equipped open kitchen. Whether it’s a quick meal or a three-course dinner, the induction hob, combi steam oven and refrigerator are at your service. You may even get new inspiration for your creative projects in the frameless walk-in shower. Repose in a space decorated with art pieces and recharge for the new day.

Studio — Embrace true urban living in apartments overlooking the city’ iconic landmarks. Independent, quiet space for work-at-home professionals and creative executives. Work smart and live in style. Designed for business travellers, expats and couples with a refined taste for living. Enter one of these smart studios, step on the luxurious oak flooring and be greeted by the full-height mirror at the foyer. Ranging from 365 to 375 square feet, the open layout comes with adequate storage space for your suits and smart casual wear. Open to stunning views, the floor-to-ceiling windows invite natural light, as well as your creativity. Take a breather on the balcony while contemplating your next innovative project. Typical floors: 5/F, 7/F, 9/F, 11/F, 15/F, 17/F, 19/F, 21/F, 23/F, 26/F, 28/F. Unit B Gross Area 365 sq.ft; Unit D Gross Area 375 sq.ft.

One-Bedroom — Savour homelike living with elaborate home-cooking in the well-equipped open kitchen. Delight in a three-course dinner away from the bustle. Go against the city’s hurly-burly and enjoy a tranquil homemade meal. Have a post-dinner drink on the balconies overlooking Wan Chai’s interesting streetscape. Ranging from 515 and 535 square feet, each one-bedroom unit comprises delineated living room and dining room, along with an open kitchen adequate for cooking a three-course dinner. Dine with your beloved in a private space with an elegant interior colour scheme. Eating out? Dress up in the closed bedroom with a make-up desk and a closet. These suites are designed for those who don’t settle for less. Unit A Gross Area 515 sq.ft; Unit E Gross Area 535 sq.ft.

Deluxe One-Bedroom — Be pampered in a spacious homey suite. Marvel at Wan Chai’s unique streetscape on the balconies. Be fascinated by the two-side streetscape of Wan Chai district on the balconies in one of these 595 square feet deluxe one-bedroom suites. Practise morning yoga to a refreshing street view and chill out with friends or family amid the charming night view. With delineated living room and dining room, each suite is designed to encourage work-life balance. Take a break from the working desk, have a nap on a cosy queen-size bed, or have an energising shower in the bigwindow private bathroom. Invited to a black tie party? The spacious make-up desk area and walk-in closet are at your service. Unit C Gross Area 595 sq.ft.

Two-Bedroom — Be cuddled by ample sunshine while marvelling at Hong Kong’s signature views. Relish in the stunning scenery of the cityscape; enjoy undisturbed tranquillity high above the vibrancy of Wan Chai district. The magnificent views of Victoria Harbour and the Mid-Levels are right in front of your eyes. These two-bedroom units come with floor-to-ceiling windows that create a harmony of light and space in all apartments. Occupying the 29th and 30th floors in two layout designs, the units offer commodious living space ranging from 657 to 990 sq.ft. name: The Stellar
tagline: The Moment We are Met
description:
You could almost gaze at the stars from The Stellar. Experience a delightful blend of comfort and sophistication at our conveniently located hotel in the heart of Hong Kong Island.

Building Concept. The building concept of The Stellar is a testament to its name, reflecting both its striking façade and its significance as an emblem of excellence in the district. The concept of The Stellar is rooted in the rich history of Chun Yeung Street. This iconic street derives its name from Guo Chun Yeung, a prominent figure in the sugar industry who played a significant role in the area's development. The sugar-crystal inspired facade captures the bustling sightseeing scene where trams gracefully winds its way through the vibrant neighbourhood of markets and authentic food stalls. The Stellar combines heritage with contemporary design, offering a truly remarkable and immersive living environment. The architecture showcases a harmonious blend of modernity and historical context. The shining exterior, resembling the brilliance of sugar crystals, stands out amidst the local neighborhood. The building’s facade adds a distinctive visual element to the streetscape. As one traverses Chun Yeung Street, creating a captivating illusion that beckons passersby to explore further. The name “Stellar” serves as a metaphor for the hotel’s commitment to excellence and serves as an outstanding beacon, illuminating the vibrant district. The essence of excellence permeates every corner of The Stellar. Upon entering the lobby, guests are welcomed by the grand double-ceiling Lounge Stellar exuding an air of elegance and sophistication. While staying true to its roots, The Stellar boldly embraces a fusion of tradition and innovation without compromising on functionality. For those seeking respite from the bustling city, the Lounge Stellar offers a cozy spot to enjoy a cup of coffee or unwind with friends and family. Guests can stay active and energized at our gym located on the fifth floor of the building.

Apartments. The Stellar embodies the essence of authentic urban living. Embracing the vibrant North Point community, we provide residents with unparalleled flexibility and comfort. With a range of fully-furnished apartments, we cater to individuals and families seeking refined living experiences. Indulge in the epitome of urban living at The Stellar Apartments. Experience maximum comfort and flexibility in our fully-furnished, meticulously designed spaces, tailored to suit refined lifestyle. The interior design of our guestrooms follows the concept of the "sugar cube" journey, continuing the theme from the exterior facade to the interior spaces. Emphasizing the cube geometry, our furniture and feature light design reflect this unique architectural inspiration. We strive to create a serene and soothing atmosphere, ensuring our guests feel relaxed and rejuvenated during their stay. Nature-inspired elements are incorporated into the guestroom design, with the use of colors and patterns reminiscent of wood in the entrance foyer and bedroom area. Soft fabrics adorn the furniture, such as stools and sofas, providing a sense of comfort and harmony. The focal point of each guestroom is a juxtaposing feature wall, adorned with textured paint that shimmers in the light. This captivating design element represents the journey of the “sugar crystal,” completing the seamless transition from the exterior to the interior.

Studio (Queen Bed) — A private, tranquil haven for remote professionals and creative executives. Elevate your work and lifestyle in harmony. Crafted with the needs of business travelers, expatriates, and couples seeking refined accommodation in mind, our elegant studios feature warm wood accents. All room windows are designed for limited opening to allow for fresh air circulation, and the thoughtful inclusion of a combined washer-dryer caters to guests’ needs.

City View Family Suite (1-Bedroom + Multi-purpose Room) — Experience the ideal blend of space and family comfort. As the proud recipient of the Gold Award for interior design of the Asia Pacific, the serviced apartment blends raw materials with modern, contemporary style, offering spacious units and chic terraces in a prime location on Hong Kong Island, perfectly suited for residents who pursue both taste and comfort.

name: Shama Central
tagline: Modern serviced apartments in Central Hong Kong
description:
Welcome to Shama Central Hong Kong. We are registered as a hotel and available for daily and long stays.

Located on Peel Street in the heart of Central, our 56 chic contemporary serviced apartments provide calming retreats in the perfect location. The city’s vibrant neighborhood boasts traditional market stalls, fashionable restaurants, antique shops and stylish boutiques all nestled side by side and offers a slice of Hong Kong life. With our unparalleled location, lavish furnishings and our staff’s care, the apartments of Shama Central exemplify luxurious urban living.

Disclaimer: The information, photographs, pictures, products, services and other materials contained and/or displayed herein are for reference only.

Neighbourhood: PMQ, SoHo. Spaces: Shama Wired business centre, Shama Gym. Accommodation: Fully furnished residences, work space, living area, washing and drying machine. Transportation: Sheung Wan MTR Station (7 min.), Central MTR Station (10 min.), Hong Kong Station (8 min.).

BUSTLING NEIGHBOURHOOD. At Shama Central Hong Kong, we want you to experience a slice of local life. Situated in Central CBD, our serviced apartments are close to PMQ and SoHo. To discover other places in the city, Sheung Wan MTR Station and Central MTR Station are within a 10-minute walk from our residences.

SENSE OF BELONGING. We love introducing travellers to each other for an even better stay. That's why we have thoughtfully created places at our apartments that are the ideal settings for our community. Build friendships at Shama Wired business centre or Shama Gym.

HOME COMFORTS. Escape from it all at Shama Central Hong Kong. Designed for business travellers and families on short or long stays, the accommodation options range from modern studios to the one-bedroom penthouse. Each spacious residence is fitted with a living area, kitchenette with Shama cookbook and bed(s) with quality mattresses and pillows. You'll also feel at peace with work space, a flat-screen TV and free Wi-Fi.

IDYLLIC LOCATION. This unmatched urban living allows easy access to all your favourite spots in town. Less time travelling means more freedom to spend doing what matters to you.

SPACIOUS AND TRANQUIL. Our urban retreat features sizeable accommodation that lends you comfort and tranquil ease even when an energetic city is right outside your window.

GETTING AROUND IS A BREEZE. Both Sheung Wan MTR Station and the Macau Ferry Terminal are within walking distance. But why venture anywhere when popular cafes, restaurants, and trending bars of PMQ and SoHo are in the neighbourhood to keep your social diary full!

ABOUT SHAMA CENTRAL HONG KONG. Originally opened in 1997 as Workings Commercial Building, the property was later converted into a premium serviced residence in the heart of Hong Kong’s most iconic district by ONYX Hospitality Group. By 2010, it rebranded as Shama Central Hong Kong, repositioning as one of Central’s most sought-after long-stay addresses.

Following a major renovation in 2022, the residence was fully refreshed with contemporary interiors, upgraded facilities and a design approach aligned with Shama’s philosophy of modern, connected urban living.

Located on Peel Street, Shama Central Hong Kong places residents steps from the city’s financial centre, the SOHO dining precinct and efficient transport links. Inside the property sits 56 serviced apartments, each a hub that reflects the city’s signature contrasts – from traditional markets down one street to hidden restaurants and boutique stores down another. Spacious layouts and smart storage solutions make the residences ideal for short-term business stays and extended relocations alike.

Long-stay residents have access to practical amenities including Shama Wired business centre, an in-house Shama Gym, self-service laundry facilities and a DVD library for maximum entertainment convenience.

With its exceptional location and thoughtful serviced-apartment design, Shama Central Hong Kong remains a leading residential choice in the heart of the city and the pride of ONYX Hospitality Group’s global portfolio.

Encounter hidden luxury in our eleven distinguished homes on Hong Kong’s legendary Hollywood. With both the Central business district and fashionable Soho on your doorstep, this is the exciting nexus where the city’s commercial world blends with bohemian life. Offering unrivaled location, beautifully furnished interiors, and our inimitable attention to detail, the serviced apartments of Shama Hollywood are the epitome of chic urban living.
