ABOUT SHAMA HOLLYWOOD HONG KONG. Opened in 2005, Shama Hollywood Hong Kong was created as an intimate boutique serviced residence on one of the city’s most iconic streets. Joining the ONYX Hospitality Group portfolio in 2010, the property has since become one of Shama’s most exclusive addresses – offering a peaceful, design-focused home amid the creative energy of Hollywood Road, Hong Kong.

With only 11 exclusive serviced apartments, Shama Hollywood delivers a level of privacy and personal space rarely found in Hong Kong’s bustling urban core. Situated conveniently between the business towers of Central and the creative energy of Soho, Shama Hollywood Hong Kong is a Shama residence designed specifically for those who want to experience both sides of the city with ease.

Each residence is exceptionally furnished following spacious layouts, complete with work areas, en-suite bathrooms, impressive kitchen facilities and warm floor-to-ceiling windows that bring in natural light and serve up some amazing city views.

Just steps away from Soho’s dining scene, the Central business district, art galleries, tai chi parks and efficient MTR connections, its position at the intersection of business and culture makes it an ideal base for those seeking both convenience and character. More home than hotel – this is where thoughtful design meets at the juncture between business and bohemia.

ABOUT SHAMA TSIM SHA TSUI HONG KONG. Opened in 2007, Shama Tsim Sha Tsui Hong Kong brings contemporary serviced-apartment living to one of Kowloon’s most energetic districts. Moments from Tsim Sha Tsui’s shopping boulevards, major MTR connections, business towers, dining streets and cultural attractions, the residence offers seamless access to both work and leisure. Residents can enjoy a full suite of amenities, including Shama Wired business centre, Shama Gym, Shama Chill rooftop garden with barbecue area, self-service laundry facilities and a DVD library. name: Shama Island North
tagline: Modern serviced apartments in Eastern District
description:
Welcome to Shama Island North Hong Kong. We are registered as a hotel and available for daily and long stays.

Located close to lively Causeway Bay and the bustling business hub in Hong Kong’s Eastern District, Shama Island North features 92 fully furnished serviced apartments ranging from open plan Studio to Two-Bedroom, and 29 contemporary hotel guest rooms. Rest amongst the vibrant metropolitan area with our well-appointed facilities, such as Shama Gym fitness centre and Shama Chill rooftop terrace.

Official page title: Shama Island North Hong Kong - Modern serviced apartments in Eastern District.

Neighbourhood: Victoria Park, Tin Hau Temple, East Coast Park Precinct Phase 1. Spaces: Shama Wired business centre, Shama Chill rooftop area, Shama Gym. Accommodation: Modern serviced apartments, shower, free Wi-Fi. Transportation: Fortress Hill MTR Station (4 min.), North Point MTR Station (6 min.).

FREEDOM TO EXPLORE. We give you a slice of local life. Exercise at Victoria Park, wish for good luck at Tin Hau Temple or take photos at East Coast Park Precinct Phase 1 located only 1.2 kilometres from our residences. For a stroll with amazing views, we are only 1.6 kilometres from Victoria Harbour. Discover other areas in the city with Fortress Hill and North Point MTR Stations situated within 6 minutes from our serviced apartments in North Point.

SENSE OF BELONGING. Warm and inviting, we've created spaces that encourages you to get to know other fellow travellers. Build friendships at the amenities at our North Point serviced apartments: Shama Wired business centre; Shama Chill rooftop area with a barbecue station; and Shama Gym.

MODERN LIVING. Make yourself at home. Fully furnished with tranquil interiors, settle in our residences with a wardrobe, shower and free Wi-Fi. The accommodation in Hong Kong also includes a safety box and a flat-screen TV with international channels.

A SLICE OF LOCAL LIFE. This culturally rich district is renowned as a wallet-friendly food haven, so get ready to take your taste buds on a culinary odyssey!

THE NEIGHBOURHOOD WITH A VIEW. A 17-minute stroll will take you to Victoria Park, East Coast Park Precinct Phase 1, and the Tin Hau Temple. What a lovely way to spend time with your loved ones and make new memories.

ROOFTOP BBQS. The Shama Chill rooftop terrace has a BBQ area for entertaining friends and family. It is also the perfect spot to meet the community and forge new friendships.

ABOUT SHAMA ISLAND NORTH HONG KONG. Opened in 2018, Shama Island North Hong Kong was introduced as a contemporary serviced residence located between the shopping streets of Causeway Bay and the business heart of Hong Kong’s Eastern District – offering a calm, connected base in one of the city’s most vibrant neighbourhoods.

As part of ONYX Hospitality Group’s extensive Hong Kong portfolio, the property has since undergone a major renovation in 2018, refreshing its rooms, facilities and communal spaces to meet the needs of both long-stay residents and short-term business guests.

Shama Island North features a selection of studio and multi-bedroom serviced apartments, alongside a collection of contemporary hotel rooms for shorter stays. Each unit features signature bright interiors, spacious workspaces, en-suite bathrooms and complimentary Wi-Fi.

Inside the property, residents can enjoy practical amenities including Shama Wired business centre, the Shama Gym, self-service laundry facilities and Shama Chill – a rooftop garden with a barbecue area and open-air seating. A DVD library adds an additional home-style touch, accessible 24-7.

Combining contemporary design with a sense of everyday practicality, Shama Island North Hong Kong is made for people who appreciate the rhythm of Hong Kong while still valuing moments of pause between it all.

AT A GLANCE. North Point is renowned as a food paradise and a culturally rich district. Located right between North Point and Fortress Hill MTR stations with 121 contemporary apartments and hotel rooms, Shama Island North revives the most intriguing city living in the area. Nearby: Victoria Park 1.2 km; East Coast Park Precinct Phase 1 1.2 km; Tin Hau Temple 1.2 km.

name: Shama Hub Metro South
tagline: Spacious & flexible apartments
description:
Located in the newly developed area of Hong Kong Southern district, Shama Hub Metro South Hong Kong is a new hub for the working individual or family looking for long-term rentals that are both close to the city yet surrounded by nature. Our selection of flexibly-furnished apartments and suites offer a contemporary hotel-home hybrid approach to life on Hong Kong Island set amidst misty mountain mornings and a bustling metropolitan coast that is best known for fresh seafood restaurants and Ocean Park frolics.

Official page title: Shama Hub Metro South Hong Kong - Spacious & flexible apartments.

Official homepage summary: Guest Rooms — Studios to family-friendly Two Bedrooms with Mountain or City view. Amenities — Fitness Space, Common kitchen, Self-service laundry. Neighbourhood — Aberdeen Country Park, The Southside - The Mall, Ocean Park Hong Kong, Ap Lei Chau. Transportation — Hong Kong International Airport (60 min.), Wong Chuk Hang MTR Station (2 min.).

BEST OF BOTH WORLDS. Just 20 minutes from the city harbours yet a stone's throw from some of Hong Kong’s best mountain reserves means you’re in the heart of it all. Aberdeen Country Park, The Southside Mall, and Ocean Park are all within walking distance while the nearby Ap Lei Chau has a wealth of business and leisure offerings that some say give Mong Kok a run for its money.

MORE THAN AN HOTEL. With flexible, social living at the forefront of what Shama Hub aspires to provide, our hotel building offers more than just rooms. Make friends over a session in the fitness space or socialise over an afternoon in the communal kitchen – our facilities allow you to become a true part of the neighbourhood at Shama Hub Metro South Hong Kong.

FLEXIBLE LIVING FOR ALL. Make a hotel your home with our modern fully furnished rooms and suites that feature smart TVs and a hotel-level of service no matter how long you stay. What’s more, our rooms are refreshingly spacious, meaning you can spread out with work, rest or play without the fear of being overwhelmed. Outside your door, a community of shared spaces and wonderful neighbours adds a cherry on top.

PRECIOUS TIMES, LASTING MEMORIES. Delight in misty morning hikes, serene evening strolls along the scenic Aberdeen Promenade, or round up the family for a trip to Ocean Park. These are some of the activities close to home.

MOUNTAIN VIEW OR CITY VIEW? A family-friendly hotel-home hybrid that offers a choice of view. Do you prefer the lights and movements of the metropolis or would you rather kick back with a rejuvenating greenery backdrop?

BRINGING PEOPLE TOGETHER. Our fully-equipped communal kitchen complete with cold storage is quite a lively to place to hang out. Come mingle with other residents and swap recipes!

ABOUT SHAMA HUB METRO SOUTH HONG KONG. Opened in 2024, Shama Hub Metro South offers flexible living for those who want city convenience with a breath of fresh air, set in the evolving Southern district of Hong Kong Island.

The property, developed by ONYX Hospitality Group, is designed to meet the needs of modern city residents seeking a comfortable home base close to both nature and the urban pulse of the city island.

With convenient access to Ocean Park, Wong Chuk Hang’s creative precinct, Aberdeen Harbour and key transport links, Shama Hub Metro South features a selection of contemporary studios and one-bedroom suites featuring smart layouts, tech-enabled amenities and workspaces, en-suite bathrooms, and complimentary Wi-Fi.

While the interiors balance comfort with practicality – making them well suited for business stays, extended visits or weekend escapes – the community-focused facilities include a Fitness Space, Common Kitchen and self-service laundry, all designed to support easy daily routines and social connection.

Set amidst the mountains and a bustling metropolitan coast, Shama Hub Metro South Hong Kong is where modern living meets local character, found squarely in a place best known for fresh seafood restaurants and Ocean Park adventures.

AT A GLANCE. Hong Kong Southern District is renowned for its mountain to sea landscape that can be enjoyed by all, whether it's mist morning hikes, rabble rousing family trips to Ocean Park or dining on freshly caught seafood after work. And with 139 contemporary rooms to choose from, Shama Hub Metro South Hong Kong is a neighbourhood unto itself too.

Nearby: The Southside - The Mall 0.2 km 2 mins; Ocean Park Hong Kong 1.1 km 15 mins; Brick Hill (Nam Long Shan) 1.7 km 4 mins; Times Square 4.6 km 9 mins; Pacific Place 5.5 km 9 mins; International Finance Centre 8 km 11 mins; The Hong Kong Convention and Exhibition Centre 8.3 km 11 mins.

OUR ROOMS. Cleverly designed with flexibility in mind, Shama Hub Metro South Hong Kong offers a generous mix of studio, bedroom and suites tailored to the needs of those working in the area. Each room features stunning views of city and nature. Kitchenettes for easy living are available in some units.

Official page title: Serviced Apartment Hong Kong | Modena by Fraser Hong Kong.

Official Open Graph description: Discover the best serviced apartment in Hong Kong for your next stay; Modena by Fraser Hong Kong offers you upscale serviced accommodation & modern amenities.

As a city that never sleeps, Hong Kong pulsates with an energy that takes visitors from morning to night through an unforgettable experience of local food, shopping, entertainment and breathtaking scenery.

Located just a 3-minute walk from Tsim Sha Tsui MTR station, Modena by Fraser Hong Kong is your gateway to Kowloon - the ‘other side’ of Hong Kong island that’s famous for its night markets, arts and culture, lively bars and trendy restaurants. Whether business or leisure brings you to this bustling metropolis, Modena by Fraser Hong Kong puts you right in the thick of the action when you want it, while offering a calming respite when you need it.

There are 36 spacious studios to pick from, featuring minimalist design, dedicated living areas and well-equipped kitchenettes that are ideal for long or short stays. Rest and recharge as you enjoy the comforts of home, with plenty of attractions right at your doorstep.

A 7-minute walk takes you to the Star Ferry Terminal, where you can hop onto the iconic green and white ferry boats that sail across Victoria Harbour for a spectacular view of the city skyline. Indulge in retail therapy in the mega Harbour City shopping mall, or catch up on the arts scene at the nearby Hong Kong Cultural Centre. Eat your way through the amazing variety of traditional cafes, noodle shops, bakeries and bars around the neighbourhood and finish off with a leisurely stroll along the Avenue of the Stars - a beautiful promenade lined with statues of legendary names such as Bruce Lee and Anita Mui.

Wind down in the comfort and privacy of your own studio apartment ranging in size from 18 sqm to 32 sqm, with complimentary WiFi access, eco-friendly bathroom amenities and a full range of services that you can choose from to customize your stay.

With so much to see and do, let Modena by Fraser Hong Kong help you to navigate your stay while providing a welcome sanctuary that takes care of all your lifestyle needs.

FAQ. Official FAQ page title: FAQ.

How can I make a reservation? To make a reservation, contact our Reception Department at +852 2262 3062.

What is the Nearest public transport from Modena By Fraser Hong Kong? Subway Station: Tsim Sha Tsui MTR Station Exit C1 or Exit L5 (3-minute walk). Railway Station: Hung Hom Station (15-minute drive). Ferry Terminal: Star Ferry Terminal (7-minute walk), China Ferry Terminal (10-minute walk).

What is the transport options from Hong Kong International Airport to Modena By Fraser Hong Kong? By Taxi: It takes approximately 35 minutes and costs about HKD 300 (including toll fees) to get to the residence. By Airport Express: Board the Airport Express train directly from the Airport to Kowloon Station, which takes about 21 minutes and costs HKD 90 one way per adult. Then, take a taxi from Kowloon Station to our residence. Subject to traffic conditions, the taxi ride should take approximately 10 minutes and cost about HKD 50.

When can I check in? You are welcome to arrive as early as you wish; however, we cannot guarantee your accommodations will be available for occupancy until after 2:00 PM. Check-out time is 12:00 noon.
